title: EAOA Championships 2019
text:
We had beautiful weather in Sheringham Park for the EAOA championships last Sunday. Peter & Steve had created some excellent courses in what is one of East Anglia's most "technical" areas (it has tricky contours, in other words!). Congratulations to Bronwen on her win in the W21 age class. The other class winners can be viewed here and the overall results on the Norfolk OC website.

Unfortunately the date clashed with a Junior selection event "up North", so some of our families were unable to attend the Sheringham event as they were orienteering in Lancaster & in the Lake District!
